scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names backend,frontend --prefix-colors blue,magenta "npm run dev --workspace=@creator-ops/backend" "npm run dev --workspace=@creator-ops/frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@creator-ops/backend && npm run build --workspace=@creator-ops/frontend
scripts.start: concurrently --kill-others --names backend,frontend --prefix-colors blue,magenta "npm run start --workspace=@creator-ops/backend" "npm run start --workspace=@creator-ops/frontend"
scripts.format: prettier --write apps package.json tsconfig.base.json eslint.config.js .prettierrc.json README.md
scripts.format:check: prettier --check apps package.json tsconfig.base.json eslint.config.js .prettierrc.json README.md
